data.llm_justification: The rule-based model underweights the severity of the compound collapse: a -92.3% BL velocity cliff combined with only 7 active days and zero hotlead engagement signals a seller who has nearly disengaged entirely, and the anomalous reply rate (133.3%, replies > BLs received) suggests stale or catch-up replies rather than healthy real-time engagement, masking true responsiveness. The TYPE_A sudden cliff trajectory with this breadth of simultaneous signal deterioration across activity, volume, and engagement dimensions indicates a much higher near-term churn risk than the 32-point score reflects.
llm_interactions: Reply rate >100% (20 replies to 15 BLs) indicates delayed/catch-up responses, not genuine engagement — inflates an otherwise positive signal
7 active days + 0 hotleads + 41 clickstream events suggests passive/automated presence rather than active selling intent
-92.3% BL velocity collapse co-occurring with low active days amplifies disengagement signal beyond what each flag captures individually
CQS 66 + zero hotlead activity together suggest both lead quality and conversion effort are simultaneously degraded
TYPE_A sudden cliff trajectory means the deterioration is recent and steep, compressing the intervention window and raising urgency beyond a gradual decline of similar magnitude

Activity trend is red: recent_enq_trend shows a sharp decline (7→9→4), activity_30d (41) is dramatically below retained sellers (444-4981) and even below most churned sellers, signaling deteriorating buyer interest and seller engagement.
